supersedes: earlier rules_verified.json (8%/4%/8% static) which described the 2-Step Standard model, not 2-Step Pro
phase2_basis: phase 1 ending balance (simulation assumption; the model page does not state a reset)
daily_drawdown_reference: higher of balance or equity at 00:00 UTC (previous day's close)
daily_drawdown_quote: The maximum daily loss allowed is 5% of your previous days ending balance/equity high. This is calculated daily at 00:00 UTC, based on the higher value of either your account balance or account equity at that time.
daily_reset_note: Fixed reference. Resets every 00:00 UTC to the higher of balance/equity at that instant. It does not ratchet up with intraday equity highs.
max_drawdown_reference: highest balance/equity minus 10% of the initial balance; never moves down
max_drawdown_quote: A 10% trailing drawdown means your account equity must not fall more than 10% from your highest balance / equity. It includes both realised and unrealised losses and is recalculated as your account value increases.
max_drawdown_worked_example: peak 105,000 -> floor 95,000; drop to 103,000 -> floor stays 95,000; rise to 108,000 -> floor 98,000
consistency_note: 50% applies to 2-Step Pro funded payouts for purchases on/after 2026-08-31; 25% before that. Not applied to the evaluation.
max_margin_note: 80% figure came from the general rules page earlier; not restated in the 2-Step Pro article. Margin usage in this test peaked at 14.7%, so it never binds.
